brand.name: RoadwiseFleet
index.title: RoadwiseFleet
index.lead: Plan, dispatch and track every load in one place. Create your fleet account in a minute and run your operation from the browser.
index.dashboardCard: Sign in with an owner or dispatcher account: org trip list, create trips, advance statuses.
index.driverCard: Sign in with a driver account: your assigned trips and the next legal status.
dash.title: RoadwiseFleet — Dispatch dashboard
dash.lead: Live data from the API. Sessions are kept in this tab only.
dash.noTrips: No trips yet. Create one above: pick an order, then optionally a driver and a truck.
dash.noOrders: No orders available for this org — create an order first.
dash.selectTrip: Select a trip to see its detail.
dash.trackingHint: Share a read-only link: route, status and timeline, no login and no PII.
dash.noEvents: No status changes yet. Use the buttons on the Trips list to advance the trip, then its history appears here.
dash.noDocuments: No documents yet. The driver attaches the POD or eCMR from the driver app.
dash.noExpenses: No expenses recorded for this trip.
dash.selectOrderFirst: Select an order before creating a trip.
driver.title: RoadwiseFleet — Driver
driver.description: RoadwiseFleet driver app: your current trip, one-thumb status updates and photo proof of delivery, online or offline.
driver.signInHint: Your trips only. Works offline once loaded.
driver.noTrips: No trips assigned to you. Your dispatcher assigns trips — check again once they have.
driver.noTripSelected: No trip selected. Choose a trip above.
driver.queueHint: Captured while offline — these send themselves when you are back online.
driver.closed: This trip is closed — no further status changes.
driver.podGate: Attach a POD photo or an eCMR below first — the server refuses POD_UPLOADED without one.
driver.captureHint: Time and GPS are attached to the photo. Without a signal it is queued on the phone and sent when you are back online.
driver.gpsUnavailable: No GPS fix — the photo will be sent without a location.
driver.gpsIdle: GPS: requested when you attach a photo.
driver.sync.rejected: The server didn't accept {count} change(s): {list}. They were removed from the queue — open the trip and try again (if it was a photo, attach a smaller one), or tell your dispatcher.
driver.offlineSaved: No connection — saved on the phone and sent when you are back online.
driver.offlineFirstLoad: You are offline. Reconnect once to load your trips, then the app works offline.
driver.serverUnreachable: Could not reach the server. Check your connection and try again — anything you captured while offline is saved on the phone.
driver.error.choosePhoto: Take or choose a photo first.
driver.error.emptyFile: That file is empty. Take the photo again and attach it.
driver.error.tooLarge: That file is larger than 10 MiB. Take the photo again at a lower resolution, or send a smaller PDF, then attach it again.
driver.error.unsupportedType: That file type isn't supported. Attach a JPEG, PNG, WebP or HEIC photo, or a PDF.
driver.error.queueFailed: Could not save the capture on this phone. Try again; if it keeps failing, tell your dispatcher.
error.network: Could not reach the server. Check your connection and try again — anything you captured while offline is saved on the phone.
doctype.pod.hint: Photo of the signed delivery note
doctype.ecmr.hint: Signed consignment note — an alternative to the POD
error.invalidCredentials: That email and password don't match an account. Check them and try again. If you're not sure of your sign-in details, ask your dispatcher or fleet admin.
error.accountLocked: Too many failed sign-in attempts, so this account is locked for 15 minutes. Wait 15 minutes and try again, or ask your fleet admin to unlock it.
error.credentialsRequired: Enter your email and password, then try again.
error.sessionExpired: Your session has ended. Sign in again to continue.
error.forbidden403: Your account doesn't have access to do this. If you need it, ask your fleet admin to change your role.
error.tripForbidden403: This trip isn't assigned to you. Ask your dispatcher to assign it to your account.
error.invalidTransition: This trip can't move from {from} to {to}. Refresh to see the current status, then use one of the buttons shown on the trip.
error.invalidStatus: That status change wasn't recognised. Refresh the page and try again.
error.emptyFile: That file is empty. Take the photo again and attach it.
error.fileTooLarge: That file is larger than 10 MiB. Take the photo again at a lower resolution, or send a smaller PDF, then attach it again.
error.unsupportedType: That file type isn't supported. Attach a JPEG, PNG, WebP or HEIC photo, or a PDF.
error.badCapture: The photo's date or location couldn't be read. Take the photo again in the app. If it keeps failing, tell your dispatcher which trip it was for.
error.badDocument: The attachment was rejected. Try attaching it again; if it still fails, ask your dispatcher to add it from the office.
error.uploadFailed: The upload failed on our side, so nothing was saved. Try again in a moment; if it still fails, tell your dispatcher which document it was.
error.payloadTooLarge: That upload is too big to send. Take the photo again at a lower resolution (or send a smaller PDF), then attach it again.
error.podRequired: Attach a POD photo or an eCMR first — the trip can't be marked as POD uploaded without one. Use Capture POD below, then confirm.
error.http: Something went wrong on our side. Try again in a moment; if it keeps happening, tell your dispatcher.
capture.badTimestamp: capturedAt must be an ISO date or epoch milliseconds
capture.geoRequired: geo.lat and geo.lng are required numbers
capture.accuracy: geo.accuracy must be a non-negative number
help.title: Help
help.lead: How RoadwiseFleet works, in plain words. You can read this page without signing in.
help.contact: Still stuck? Ask your dispatcher. If you were sent a tracking link, ask the carrier that sent it.
help.openNoSignIn: Read the help page (no sign-in needed)
help.start.title: Getting started
help.start.signIn: Sign in with the email and password your organisation gave you. There is no separate app to install.
help.start.roles: What you see depends on your role: a dispatcher plans and assigns trips, a driver updates their own trip, an accountant works with invoices.
help.start.language: Use the language selector in the header to switch between English, German, Polish and Turkish. Your choice is remembered on this device.
help.start.offline: The driver app keeps working without signal: status updates and photos are queued on the phone and sent when the connection returns.
help.statuses.title: The status of a trip
help.statuses.note: A trip moves forward one step at a time. The app only offers the next step, and every step is recorded with who did it and when.
help.trips.title: Planning a trip
help.trips.create: A trip is created from an order: choose the order, the driver, the truck and the agreed rate, then create it. The trip starts as Draft.
help.trips.assign: Assign a driver from the trip screen. Assigning a driver moves the trip from Draft to Assigned.
help.trips.next: The driver updates the status on their own screen as the delivery progresses. The dispatcher can also move it from the trip screen.
help.trips.documents: Documents belong to the trip: the proof of delivery, the eCMR and invoices are uploaded on the trip screen and reviewed there.
help.track.title: Sending a tracking link
help.track.create: Open the trip and create a tracking link. The link belongs to that trip only and can be sent to the customer by email or chat.
help.track.what: The tracking page shows the route, the current status, the status history and whether a proof of delivery is available. It never shows rates, invoices or contact details.
help.track.expiry: The link stops working when it expires, and an old link cannot be extended. Create a new one if the customer needs it again.
help.track.customer: Anyone with the link can read it, so send it only to the customer. An invalid or expired link says so and never shows trip data.
help.solo.title: Solo driver: your first run
help.solo.signUp: Create a solo driver account with your name, email, phone and password. Adding the truck plate and body is optional.
help.solo.beacon: Turn the beacon on while you are available. It shows your position to dispatchers who are looking for a truck, and you can turn it off at any time.
help.solo.offers: The loads board lists open loads with from, to and equipment. Accept the posted rate, or place your own offer with a price and pickup times.
help.solo.jobs: Your jobs move Draft, Assigned, Loaded, In transit, Delivered, POD uploaded. Attach the proof of delivery before the last step.
help.solo.customers: You can add your own customers, create a job for them, and share the tracking link with them.
help.customer.title: You were sent a tracking link
help.customer.open: Open the link on your phone. Nothing to install, and no account is needed.
help.customer.shows: The page shows where the shipment is going, its current status and its status history, as the carrier updates it.
help.customer.pod: When the delivery is complete, the page says whether a proof of delivery is available.
help.customer.expired: If the page says the link is invalid or has expired, ask the carrier who sent it for a new one.
help.faq.title: Common questions
help.faq.status: A status will not change: only the next step is allowed, so check the current status first. A proof of delivery is needed before POD uploaded.
help.faq.stuck: A page is empty or an update does not appear: refresh once. The driver app also has a sync button that sends anything queued.
help.faq.notifications: Automatic SMS and WhatsApp messages are not part of the pilot: follow the app or the link, and ask your dispatcher if something is unclear.
